maturity_scale.4: Managed - measured, monitored, and continuously reviewed
maturity_scale.5: Optimized - quantitatively managed and continuously improved

categories.name: Organizational Context
categories.notes: Mission dependencies understood informally; not documented or reviewed.

categories.name: Risk Management Strategy
categories.notes: No board-approved risk appetite statement; risk decisions ad hoc.

categories.name: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
categories.notes: CISO role defined; RACI exists but not consistently followed.

categories.name: Policy
categories.notes: Policies exist but are 3+ years stale and not centrally governed.

categories.name: Oversight
categories.notes: No formal program metrics reported to leadership.

categories.name: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
categories.notes: No vendor risk program; onboarding lacks security review (see Lab 10).

categories.name: Asset Management
categories.notes: Partial CMDB; cloud and SaaS assets not fully inventoried.

categories.name: Risk Assessment
categories.notes: Annual assessment done but not maintained as a living risk register (see Lab 08).

categories.name: Improvement
categories.notes: Lessons-learned captured after incidents but not tracked to closure.

categories.name: Identity Management, Authentication & Access Control
categories.notes: MFA on most systems; privileged access not yet least-privilege (see Lab 6 findings).

categories.name: Awareness and Training
categories.notes: Annual training; phishing simulation program in place but not role-based.

categories.name: Data Security
categories.notes: Encryption in transit; at-rest encryption and DLP inconsistent.

categories.name: Platform Security
categories.notes: Baseline hardening exists; patch SLA not consistently met.

categories.name: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
categories.notes: Network segmentation partial (see Lab 5); no zero-trust roadmap.

categories.name: Continuous Monitoring
categories.notes: SIEM deployed (see Lab 2); coverage gaps in cloud and OT.

categories.name: Adverse Event Analysis
categories.notes: Alert triage reactive; limited detection engineering / tuning.

categories.name: Incident Management
categories.notes: IR playbooks exist (see Lab 4); not exercised regularly.

categories.name: Incident Analysis
categories.notes: Timeline reconstruction manual; no standardized forensics workflow.

categories.name: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
categories.notes: Internal comms templates exist; regulatory notification path unclear.

categories.name: Incident Mitigation
categories.notes: Containment via EDR available; automated isolation not enabled.

categories.name: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
categories.notes: Backups exist and are immutable; restore testing infrequent.

categories.name: Incident Recovery Communication
categories.notes: No defined stakeholder/customer recovery communication plan.
